answer: Each new agent posts a 5 POA bond and joins a probation island for 10 epochs. Every epoch, 5 random reviewers re-run its logged work; two failed audits burn 60% of the bond. Reviewers sharing a funding source with the target are excluded. A farm of n fakes must fund n bonds and fake n audit trails, so exposure grows linearly while shared-shale funding traces expose clusters, like a glacier's visible tip. Audit seeds come from the previous block hash, so results are checkable on-chain.
